The '''1958–59 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 57th staging of the [[Copa del Rey]]. The competition began on 21 December 1958 and concluded on 21 June 1959 with the final.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Ferrer |first=Carles Lozano |date=2001-10-04 |title=Spain - Cup 1959 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1959.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250527154408/https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1959.html |archive-date=2025-05-27 |access-date=2026-03-21 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>
